Let theta be the nonstraight angle and OC=OD=R. The chord midpoint M is inside the angle, CM=DM=CD/2, and OM bisects the angle by congruent right triangles. Equal-radius circles centered at C,D are tangent at M when r=CD/2; their arcs meet there. Thus strictly greater than CD/2 is not necessary for the stated construction. The narrower Chinese technical distinction between crossing and tangency was not supplied to the learner. Preserve the intended C key but do not enforce exclusive grading.
